**Finding: Compliant** (no redline)

Section 22 hits the preferred position on all material terms:
- **Frequency:** once in any twelve-month period (22.1)
- **Notice:** at least thirty days' prior written notice, during normal business hours, no unreasonable disruption
- **Manner:** off-site where practicable, by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality
- **Cost:** Vendor bears audit costs unless underpayment exceeds five percent (22.2)
- **System access:** expressly barred — no direct access to our systems, unrelated Customer Data, privileged material, or another supplier's confidential information

Section 22.3 adds further customer-side benefits (findings are our Confidential Information, we receive the final report, and paying a shortfall resolves the audited quantity issue). A document-wide search found no other inspection, verification, monitoring or telemetry-based audit right binding us. Nothing to redline.
